verdicts.evidence: The Billing card icon is a filled blue credit card with yellow and orange marks, and the Privacy icon is a filled green shield with a check mark; the other six icons are thin navy line drawings (bolt, key, box, plug, bell, life ring).

The cards include "Set up your workspace and invite your team." and "Connect calendars, chat tools, and storage." next to "Orders and shipping: Track a delivery or start a return.", exactly as quoted.
